title: Brandvarnare i bostäder
request: Actual domestic smoke alarm,not camera or heat detector; archived source legal statement,no added current-law interpretation.

title: Tillräckligt många
request: Distinct actual domestic smoke-alarm object/room installation; no invented placement distances or standard.

title: Varuhus och järnaffärer
request: Actual hardware-store setting with alarm relevance,no endorsement,current stock or prices.

title: 60 kvadratmeter
request: One smoke-alarm object with exact source60square-metre area,no invented installation radius or floorplan.

title: Exempel: 65 kvadratmeter
request: Explicit EXAMPLE65square metres -> TWO alarms; distinct area/count illustration,not one alarm per home.

title: Varje våning separat
request: IF more than one floor,measure each floor separately; never sum all floors first.

title: Brandvarnare på varje våning
request: Alarm on EACH of two schematic levels,no invented ceiling clearances or placement instruction.

title: Kontrollera funktionen
request: Actual smoke-alarm/test-button object; source regular checking,no invented weekly/monthly schedule or test procedure.

title: Batterier vid behov
request: Actual household battery/alarm objects; IF NEEDED and preferably once a year,not mandatory exact interval or model compatibility assurance.

title: Bastu i hemmet
request: Verified actual Finnish home sauna; source OFTEN,not every dwelling.

title: Inget på bastuugnen
request: Sauna heater with object storage prohibited EVEN WHEN UNUSED; source fire risk,no allegation about actual household.

title: Inte tvätt nära aggregatet
request: Laundry ABOVE OR NEAR heater prohibited,no invented safe distance or drying method.

title: Inte förråd
request: Sauna bench/heater plus storage boxes prohibited,distinct from heater-top rule.

title: Stäng av efter användning
request: Actual electric sauna-heater control with source OFF-after-use cue,no invented model-specific switch position.

title: Lång tid utan användning
request: IF electric heater unused for long time,source fuse-removal relationship abstractly; no invented duration,live wiring or electrical-work steps.

title: Kontroll före du går
request: Leaving-home cue plus BOTH stove AND oven AND example iron OFF,no extra device requirements.

title: Brandsläckare hemma
request: Actual extinguisher as recommended object,no invented class,rating,inspection interval or discharge steps.

title: Vissa trappuppgångar
request: Verified actual stairwell extinguisher; SOME apartment blocks,not guarantee in every stairwell.

title: Var är närmaste släckare
request: Extinguisher-location/question relationship,no fabricated building floorplan or guaranteed access.

title: Släckningsfilt hemma
request: Actual correctly identified fire blanket/case,not ordinary textile,no invented rating or handling procedure.

title: Exempel nära spisen
request: Distinct fire blanket near cooking context,FOR EXAMPLE qualification,no invented height/distance.

title: Het spis under uppsikt
request: Cooking pot and attentive-person cue with unattended state prohibited,no staged live hazard.

title: Försiktighet på natten
request: Night/moon and cooking object: extra care IF cooking at night,not a blanket ban.

title: Inte berusad vid matlagning
request: Cooking/alcohol impairment prohibition,no real person accused or invented safe amount/time.

title: Inga föremål på spisen
request: Actual empty stovetop with source no-storage cue,never stage ignition.

title: Kan sättas på av misstag
request: Child OR pet OR adult as source possibilities linked to cooker control,no invented actual incident/control bypass.

title: Föremål kan fatta eld
request: Accidental-on stove plus stored object MAY cause fire,not certainty or live reenactment.

title: Fettbrand: kväv elden
request: IF cooking FAT burns,source examples pot LID OR fire BLANKET covering flame; abstract objects,no added handling steps or guarantee.

title: Fettbrand: inte vatten
request: Explicit preceding cooking-FAT-FIRE context and water prohibited,not universal claim about every fire.

title: Stäng av elapparater
request: Actual household appliance plus OFF-after-use source cue,no brand-specific operating instructions.

title: Dra ur strykjärnet
request: Actual iron and clearly disconnected plug,no exposed wiring or damaged live equipment.

title: Trasig apparat eller sladd
request: Poor appliance condition OR damaged cord -> no use; anonymous schematic,no repair guide.

title: Elbrand: inte vatten
request: IF electrical appliance burns,water prohibition; distinguish from fat-fire rule.

title: Exempel: brandsläckare
request: Electrical-appliance fire context plus FOR EXAMPLE extinguisher,no invented extinguisher type/application steps.

title: Inget på elvärme
request: Actual electric heater/radiator with no-covering cue,correctly identified,no invented clearance dimensions.

title: Rök inte inomhus
request: Indoor house and cigarette prohibition,no real smoker allegation or added outdoor law.

title: Ljus under uppsikt
request: Actual candle object with attendance cue,no claim photo proves supervision.

title: Inte nära gardiner
request: Candle/curtain proximity prohibited EVEN IF person present,no invented safe distance.

title: Läcka: avstängningsventil
request: Actual domestic water shutoff valve correctly identified; conditional TRY to close,no invented turn direction/plumbing repair steps.

title: Höghus eller radhus
request: IF apartment block OR row house -> notify building-maintenance emergency number immediately; no fake digits or112substitution.

title: Villa: rörfirma
request: IF detached house -> on-call plumbing firm; distinct from maintenance/112,no fabricated contact.

title: Säkerhetslås när du går
request: Actual domestic security-lock object with away-from-home cue; IF lock exists,lock when absent,no bypass information or certification claim.

title: Inte säkerhetslåst hemma
request: AT HOME -> do NOT lock source security lock,distinct from ordinary door latch; not advice to leave outside door open.

title: Inbrott: 112
request: IF someone breaks into home -> source112and phone,no staged perpetrator/victim or extra confrontation advice.

title: Täta hus på vintern
request: Verified Finnish winter residential setting; illustrative warmth/airtightness context,no measured performance claim.

title: Fukt kan ge problem
request: Moisture MAY damage wall/floor in preceding airtight-house context,no invented mould diagnosis/threshold or named property allegation.

title: Lite vatten vid städning
request: Actual damp-cleaning cloth/floor object; avoid excessive water,no invented volume,chemical or product recommendation.

title: Torka noggrant
request: Distinct drying-cloth/floor object; IF wet then dry thoroughly,no invented time limit/guarantee.

title: Ventiler för fuktig luft
request: Actual domestic ventilation vent,not heating grille; outward moist-air function,no invented airflow measurement.

title: Öppna och rena året om
request: Ventilation stays OPEN AND CLEAN ALL YEAR; do not close,no invented cleaning interval/procedure.

title: Brand: ring genast
request: IF building fire,source emergency call immediately;112from context,no extra evacuation/medical instructions.

title: Rök i trappuppgången
request: Apartment building AND smoke in stairwell -> do NOT leave apartment; smoke outside door,not universal stay-home rule for every fire.

title: Ingen hiss vid brand
request: IF building fire,lift use prohibited,no added escape route or claim specific lift works.

title: Alla hemma behöver veta
request: Household adults AND children knowing source response,no invented procedures or claim actual photographed family practiced drill.

title: Fri balkongdörr
request: Actual unobstructed balcony door; no furniture blocking it,can exit IF needed; no jump/climb instruction or universal balcony evacuation rule.
